mail.com and outlook.com are legitimate services. The three sender addresses are attacker-created accounts on them; do not block the services. The feed maps the addresses, not the domains.

Cloudflare (Turnstile and CDN fronting), NameSilo (typical registrar), OneDrive and 1drv.ms (an attacker-owned share is proxied as a same-origin page) and Microsoft Entra sign-in are all legitimate infrastructure used by the actor. None is an indicator.

Proofpoint labels each domain as first-stage or second-stage and gives one explicit pair (driftshare.co then globalfileshareplatform.com). Any other pairing by first-seen month is an inference and is not stated by Proofpoint.
First-seen dates run from December 2025 to July 2026. Proofpoint publishes no takedown or sinkhole status. Re-validate before treating any of these as live.

TA419 is described by Proofpoint as China-aligned and espionage-motivated; activity 'likely supports wider Chinese intelligence objectives'. No other vendor name mapping is published. UNK_SweetSpecter, another China-aligned cluster that sent AI-themed phishing, is described as separate.
No full URLs, no shortener domain, no file hashes, no Emerging Threats signatures and no IP list beyond 108.61.163.187 appear in the Proofpoint post.
